name: homeaway_api_ruby
what_it_holds: Official (now-archived, org name still 'homeaway') Ruby SDK for the HomeAway Partner/API — auth and endpoint wrappers for listings/reservations, not a dataset. The underlying HomeAway public API is defunct post Vrbo/Expedia consolidation, so the client likely no longer resolves against a live endpoint.
why_useful: Historical evidence of what an official HomeAway API surface looked like (listing/reservation objects); of essentially no practical pull value today since HomeAway's own API has been retired, but documents the data schema HomeAway once exposed.

name: SIGNAL-STR-Listing-Matcher
what_it_holds: A Flask app that resolves a physical address + unit number to its live Airbnb/Vrbo listing, tested across three commercial STR data platforms (Apify, AirROI, RapidAPI) using a direct-lookup-first, geocode-and-filter-fallback strategy. No data committed; it is a matcher/orchestrator that calls paid third-party STR data APIs (Apify, AirROI, RapidAPI), not a free data source itself.
why_useful: Useful map of which commercial vendors (AirROI, Apify STR scrapers, RapidAPI STR listing endpoints) exist for address-to-listing matching across Airbnb+Vrbo — worth knowing as a paid-vendor landscape reference even though it delivers no free data itself and would require paid keys we are told not to use.
